'''CRILOC Horses''' were [[Color/Legends|gray]]-[[Hair/Legends|furred]], black-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] domesticated creatures that were used as mounts and beasts-of-burden in [[Desert/Legends|desert]] regions. CRILOC Horses possessed gray skin, clawed [[Limb/Legends|limbs]], a bushy tail, and short, pointed [[Ear/Legends|ears]] located on the top of its head. The creatures each had a [[Tooth/Legends|fanged]] [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] that contained a pink [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]]. They could be [[Saddle/Legends|saddled]] and mounted by [[Human/Legends|Humans]], and were sometimes startled by [[combat-scout droid]]s.<ref name="SWAV" />

At some point, a CRILOC Horse was ridden by a [[Unidentified Human on a mount|Human male]] and was accompanied by the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] in a desert, where they met a combat-scout droid that alarmed and frightened the creature, despite the fact that the droid was not aggressive.<ref name="SWAV" />

==Behind the scenes==
The CRILOC Horse was created by artist [[Roy Grinnell]] for the [[2010]] book ''[[Star Wars Art: Visions]]''<ref name="SWAV" /> and the artwork featuring the creature was later included in the [[Star Wars: The Complete Saga|Star Wars Blu-ray]] booklet.<ref name="Insider 130">{{InsiderCite|130|The Art Side of the Force}}</ref> Grinnell's artwork was entitled "Wait... the Droid Just Wants to Say Hello".<ref name="SWAV" /> The creature was subsequently named in an interview for the feature, "''[[The Art Side of the Force]]''," which appeared in [[Star Wars Insider 130|''Star Wars Insider'' 130]], in [[December 13]], [[2011]].<ref name="Insider 130" />
